color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no twist. Light register: pageBackground #ffffff. Vaporwave-compatible palette: cyan #63cabe, purple #b79cff, deep indigo #1b1b37, lavender border #cccce1. Ideal for neon glow effects on white backgrounds.

type-system.twistDescription: Vaporwave transformation: Exo 2 700 (display, 85px h1, 56px h2, uppercase, 0.1em tracking) + Russo One 400 (h3, buttons, nav, 0.08-0.12em tracking, uppercase) + Space Mono 400 (body, 13px). Three Google Fonts CDN imports. Retro-futuristic 80s sci-fi aesthetic.

motion-system.twistDescription: Vaporwave slow-dreamy: base 0.8s, enter 1.5s, cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) easing. Keyframes: neon-glow pulse (infinite), scanline sweep, ethereal entrance (scale+fade+rise), slow-slide-up. No linear/instant easing. Everything flows like worn VHS tape.

grid-system.twistDescription: Cinematic 12-column grid: 1600px max-width, 28px gutters. Perspective grid floor utility (.vaporwave-grid: rotateX 65deg) creates 3D horizon effect. Neon dividers via CSS variable references. Utilities: .vapor-full, .vapor-centered (neon-cyan left border), .vapor-split (4fr/6fr with neon-purple divider), .vapor-half, .vapor-third.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Vaporwave Dreamy Scale: 120px hero padding, 112px row padding, 80px container gaps. Asymmetric nav (28px top / 12px bottom — dreamy gravity). Grid 24px gaps. Hero floating monument scale. Everything breathes.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Neon glow hover: 0.4s ease-in-out on all state changes. Hover adds box-shadow 0 0 12-16px neon glow (cyan or purple). Focus rings: 4px solid with ambient glow. Cards glow purple on hover. Phosphor afterimage: dual-layer box-shadow. Slow dreamy transitions coherent with motion base 0.8s.

nav-system.twistDescription: Vaporwave glass HUD: backdropFilter blur(12px), rgba(255,255,255,0.12) fill, 1px rgba-cyan border-bottom. Russo One all-caps 0.75rem — retro-futuristic nav typography. 64px height. Scrolled state: blur 16px + purple glow shadow. Check C FIXED: changed from Orbitron to Russo One (assembled type system has Russo One).

concept-summary.twistDescription: Shifted from premium interactive portfolio to lo-fi/vaporwave streaming dreamscape. Concept: Neon Reverie — streaming and discovery platform for lo-fi, vaporwave, and synthwave music. Analog-warm control zone + neon dreamscape media zone. 3 video placements: neon-descent-loop.mp4 (60-90s), lo-fi-studio-ambient.mp4 (45-60s), chromatic-abstract-loop.mp4 (90-120s).

A_colorContrast.notes: navText #1b1b37 (brightness ~30) vs navBackground transparent → pageBackground #ffffff (brightness 255) — maximum contrast. bodyText #1b1b37 vs pageBackground #ffffff — maximum contrast.

B_motionInteractionCoherence.notes: Motion base 0.8s. Interaction hover transitions 0.4s. Ratio 2× — well under 5× threshold. Both use cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) — stylistically unified.

C_navFontAvailability.notes: Agent 7 returned 'Orbitron' — NOT in assembled type system (Exo 2, Russo One, Space Mono). Fixed inline: changed nav fontFamily to 'Russo One', sans-serif. Russo One is the nav/button/h3 font per the assembled type system.
